title: BSC Audit Engine: Fail-Closed Audit-Descent Kernel
description: Version 0.3.0-alpha.18 is a public research preview of a fail-closed structural checker for typed scientific claims. It replaces the alpha.17 GitHub-rejected operatorname macro with renderer-safe mathematical notation, makes the observation-descent composition and empty-family convention explicit, states the exact-quotient hypotheses directly, and adds a permanent active-math macro regression. No engine algorithm, accepted schema, degree-two route, or new mathematical authority is added. Exact replay conclusions remain bound to their subject, evidence, predicate, scope, method, and authority; mathematical correctness, documentation syntax, local tests, release identity, actual GitHub rendering, external scientific truth, and deployment authority remain separate. Release assets are built from exact tagged Git objects, keylessly attested before publication, and redownloaded for byte comparison. The protocol component remains byte-identical to 0.3.0-alpha.13, and the live Custom GPT remains the separately observed alpha.10 interface; the alpha.18 generated package is only an unvalidated future live-update candidate and indexed Knowledge bytes remain NON_ADMISSIBLE_UNHASHABLE. ChatGPT uploads are processed under the user's applicable terms and settings and are not local-only. This metadata applies to the Apache-2.0 software release assets; research material under research/ is separately governed by CC BY 4.0.
